tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), the Coast Guard may not procure buoy chain—

children.text: that is not manufactured in the United States; or
substantially all of the components of which are not produced or manufactured in the United States.

tree.text: The Coast Guard may procure buoy chain that is not manufactured in the United States if the Secretary determines that—

children.text: the price of buoy chain manufactured in the United States is unreasonable; or

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 97 of this title as this section.
